subject: M3 kernel extraction at Aeneas 1238879f (whole noble-kernel crate, Rust subject 12be5375): 2,271 generated and 73 external definitions; re-derived 2026-11-18 for #97 after adapter identities became byte arrays and the join assertions lost their messages, so no generated literal-size axiom reaches the checker. Generated definitions are extracted except the fixture-checked acceptance::check (its twenty-nine citations are carried over and re-verified against the regenerated subject); external definitions are modeled except the five #[charon::opaque] helpers; the unused String/&str ne model is removed.

functions.note: Fixture-checked, not proved: the 26 cited fixture correspondences are closed native_decide equalities between the extracted checker and the reference model on one request and candidate each, and accepted_via_refinement, accepted_via_refinement_v1 and outcomes_via_refinement_v1 are conditional on the refinement equation they are cited for. No citation is a strict universal statement, so universal checker correctness is not established (#88). Since #97 compares adapter identities as byte arrays and keeps the join assertions without messages, the checker no longer depends on generated literal-size axioms: the fixtures keep the native axiom class through native_decide, and accepted_via_refinement, accepted_via_refinement_v1 and outcomes_via_refinement_v1 use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
